summary: The school district expresses strong support for preserving the E-Rate program, emphasizing the critical role of reliable and affordable internet connectivity in education and the financial and educational consequences of reducing or eliminating E-Rate support.

claims.argument: Any changes to E-Rate would impose additional financial pressure on school districts and could force difficult choices between maintaining essential technology infrastructure and funding other educational needs.
claims.evidence_quote: For school districts, every dollar matters. E-Rate support allows us to direct local resources toward the priorities that matter most to our students—quality instruction, student support, educators, and the programs that help our young people thrive. Reducing or eliminating this support would put additional financial pressure on districts and could force difficult choices between maintaining essential technology infrastructure and funding other important educational needs.
